units.name: line4a_yes_no
units.description: Was there a failure to transmit to the plan any participant contributions within the time period described in 29 CFR 2510.3-102? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: line4b_yes_no
units.description: Were any loans by the plan or fixed income obligations due the plan in default as of the close of the plan year or classified during the year as uncollectible? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: line4c_yes_no
units.description: Were any leases to which the plan was a party in default or classified during the year as uncollectible? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: line4d_yes_no
units.description: Were there any nonexempt transactions with any party-in-interest? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: line4e_yes_no
units.description: Was this plan covered by a fidelity bond? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: line4f_yes_no
units.description: Did the plan have a loss, whether or not reimbursed by the plan’s fidelity bond, that was caused by fraud or dishonesty? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: line4g_yes_no
units.description: Did the plan hold any assets whose current value was neither readily determinable on an established market nor set by an independent third party appraiser? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: line4h_yes_no
units.description: Did the plan receive any noncash contributions whose value was neither readily determinable on an established market nor set by an independent third party appraiser? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: line4i_yes_no
units.description: Did the plan have assets held for investment? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: line4j_yes_no
units.description: Were any plan transactions or series of transactions in excess of 5% of the current value of plan assets? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: line4k_yes_no
units.description: Were all the plan assets either distributed to participants or beneficiaries, transferred to another plan, or brought under the control of the PBGC? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: line4l_yes_no
units.description: Has the plan failed to provide any benefit when due under the plan? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: line4m_yes_no
units.description: If this is an individual account plan, was there a blackout period? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: line4n_yes_no
units.description: If 4m was answered “Yes,” check the “Yes” box if you either provided the required notice or one of the exceptions to providing the notice applied under 29 CFR 2520.101-3.

units.name: line5a_yes_no
units.description: Has a resolution to terminate the plan been adopted during the plan year or any prior plan year? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: pbgc_insurance_coverage
units.description: Was the plan a defined benefit plan covered under the PBGC insurance program at any time during this plan year? Mark Yes, No or Not determined.
